title: ENHANCING CROSS-LINGUAL TRANSFER BY MANIFOLD MIXUP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the "cross-lingual transfer gap" by comparing zero-shot cross-lingual transfer performance (Accuracy, F1, Exact Match) and cross-lingual representation discrepancy (using Centered Kernel Alignment scores) between a high-resource source language (English) and 40 diverse target languages across multiple understanding tasks in the XTREME benchmark.
